blocks.en: Four techniques: **vary sentence length**, **keep paragraphs short**, **use lists**, and **add headings and subheadings**.
blocks.ms: Empat teknik: **ubah panjang ayat**, **pastikan perenggan pendek**, **guna senarai**, dan **tambah tajuk dan subtajuk**.

en: **Paragraphs:** 100 words or fewer; inviting to the reader; connect ideas; emphasise key ideas; divide large subjects; don’t go overboard
**Lists:** set off important ideas; simplify and break down complex subjects; highlight sequences of ideas
**Headings:** organise lengthy material; grab attention; increase understanding; group related paragraphs; visually indicate shifts
ms: **Perenggan:** 100 perkataan atau kurang; menarik pembaca; sambung idea; tekankan idea utama; bahagi subjek besar; jangan keterlaluan
**Senarai:** tonjolkan idea penting; ringkaskan dan pecahkan subjek kompleks; serlahkan urutan idea
**Tajuk:** susun bahan panjang; tarik perhatian; tingkat kefahaman; kumpul perenggan berkaitan; tunjuk peralihan secara visual

q.en: Three kinds of messages to revise based on media and content?
q.ms: Tiga jenis mesej untuk disemak mengikut media dan kandungan?

a.en: Informal, digital and complex messages.
a.ms: Tidak formal, digital dan kompleks.

q.en: What three things do you evaluate in a first draft?
q.ms: Tiga perkara dinilai dalam draf pertama?

a.en: Content, organization, tone.
a.ms: Kandungan, organisasi, nada.

q.en: How do you promote the writer’s success when evaluating their work?
q.ms: Bagaimana membantu kejayaan penulis semasa menilai karya mereka?

a.en: Support the writer’s intent, avoid imposing your own style, learn what they wanted to accomplish.
a.ms: Sokong niat penulis, elak paksa gaya sendiri, fahami hasrat penulis.

q.en: Four techniques to improve readability?

a.en: Vary sentence length, keep paragraphs short, use lists, add headings and subheadings.
a.ms: Ubah panjang ayat, perenggan pendek, guna senarai, tambah tajuk.

q.en: Short, medium and long sentence lengths?
q.ms: Panjang ayat pendek, sederhana dan panjang?

a.en: Short: up to 15 words; medium: 15–25; long: over 25.
a.ms: Pendek: hingga 15; sederhana: 15–25; panjang: lebih 25.

q.en: Maximum words in a short paragraph?

a.en: 100 words or fewer.
a.ms: 100 perkataan atau kurang.

q.en: What do headings do for readers?

a.en: Organise lengthy material, grab attention, increase understanding, emphasise key ideas, show shifts.
a.ms: Susun bahan panjang, tarik perhatian, tingkat kefahaman, tekankan idea utama, tunjuk peralihan.

q.en: Name the eight steps for clarity.

a.en: Break up long sentences; rewrite hedging; impose parallelism; correct dangling modifiers; reword noun sequences; replace camouflaged verbs; clarify structure; clarify awkward references.
a.ms: Pecah ayat panjang; tulis semula hedging; parallelism; betulkan dangling modifier; tulis semula jujukan kata nama; ganti kata kerja tersembunyi; jelaskan struktur; jelaskan rujukan.

q.en: Four tips for conciseness?

a.en: Delete unnecessary words, shorten long words and phrases, eliminate redundancies, rewrite.
a.ms: Buang perkataan tidak perlu, pendekkan, hapus kelewahan, tulis semula.

q.en: What is a hedging sentence?

a.en: A sentence that is vague or noncommittal and should be rewritten to be clear. (Definition from textbook idea; slides only list the step.)
a.ms: Ayat kabur yang perlu ditulis semula agar jelas. (Takrif dari idea buku teks; slaid hanya senaraikan langkah.)

q.en: Four principles of effective design?

a.en: Consistency, balance, restraint, detail.
a.ms: Konsistensi, keseimbangan, kawalan, perincian.

q.en: Five document design elements?

a.en: White space, margins, justification, typefaces, type styles.
a.ms: Ruang putih, margin, justification, typefaces, type styles.

q.en: Four tips for designing for mobile devices?
q.ms: Empat tip reka bentuk mudah alih?

a.en: Think in small chunks, use white space generously, format simply, experiment with layouts.
a.ms: Bahagian kecil, ruang putih, format ringkas, cuba susun atur.

q.en: Four kinds of problems found in proofreading?
q.ms: Empat jenis masalah dalam semakan bukti?

a.en: Language errors, missing material, design errors, typographical errors.
a.ms: Kesilapan bahasa, bahan tertinggal, reka bentuk, menaip.

q.en: List eight proofreading tips.

a.en: Multiple passes; perceptual tricks; double-check high-priority items; distance; vigilance; focus; review digital on paper; take your time.
a.ms: Beberapa lintasan; helah persepsi; semak keutamaan; jarak; waspada; fokus; semak atas kertas; ambil masa.

q.en: Why review complex digital documents on paper?
q.ms: Kenapa semak dokumen digital kompleks atas kertas?

a.en: It is one of the proofreading tips; paper helps you catch errors missed on screen.
a.ms: Ia salah satu tip; kertas membantu kesan kesilapan yang terlepas di skrin.

q.en: Four factors in choosing a distribution method?

a.en: Cost, convenience, time, security and privacy.
a.ms: Kos, kemudahan, masa, keselamatan dan privasi.

q.en: Name two questions to ask when evaluating another’s writing.
q.ms: Namakan dua soalan semasa menilai tulisan orang lain.

a.en: e.g. What is the purpose? Who is the target audience? Is the tone appropriate?
a.ms: cth Apakah tujuan? Siapa audiens sasaran? Adakah nada sesuai?

q.en: What are lists used for?

a.en: Set off important ideas, simplify complex subjects, highlight sequences.
a.ms: Tonjol idea penting, ringkaskan subjek kompleks, serlah urutan.

q.en: What is “restraint” in design?

a.en: One of the four principles: avoid overdoing fonts, styles and effects. (Meaning from textbook idea; slides only name it.)
a.ms: Satu daripada empat prinsip: elak berlebihan font, gaya dan kesan. (Maksud dari idea buku teks; slaid hanya menamakannya.)
